svg.title: Cost of a 500 millilitre vinegar-water batch versus two brand sprays
svg.desc: Bars for a 500 millilitre half-vinegar batch using No Name vinegar at 99 cents a litre, 500 millilitres of Mr. Clean, and 500 millilitres of Dawn Powerwash at the unit prices opened for this guide. The jobs are not the same.
svg.text: The green bar is cheaper. It is also not a disinfectant and not a substitute for the other two products.

g.text: Vinegar and water, half and half

svg.text: Vinegar: No Name 1 L at $0.99 on the No Frills flyer 24-30 Sep 2026, Toronto Pacific. 250 mL is $0.25.
Mr. Clean: $13.49 for 5.2 L on the Costco East list posted 10 Jun 2026. Half a litre is $1.30.
Dawn Powerwash: 3 x 635 mL at $12.99 on that list, after a $3.50 saving the list said expired 21 Jun 2026.
Scale: $3.50 = 410 px. A soap-and-water batch is under one cent of PC dish soap and is not drawn.
Saving Optimizer, 26 Sep 2026. Do not mix any of these with bleach.
